temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated friend and doctor with a demanding job, but he had not yet concluded that Gary's health was in serious danger.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan updates from general awareness of Gary's dedication to specific concern that Gary's overwork is harming his health; Gary's refusal shows work obligations are a major barrier.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworked to an unhealthy degree and is reluctant or unable to step away because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, sympathetic, and somewhat disappointed by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary address his overwork, perhaps by persuading him to take a break or finding another way to support his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was overworked and that hospital workload was the main cause of his stress; he hoped the retreat would help Gary relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan shifts from believing Gary's problem is mainly ordinary hospital workload to suspecting there is a deeper personal or professional issue Gary is avoiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is troubled by more than simple overwork; there is something significant he is not sharing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently about his suspicions and encourage him to open up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He says he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary had a deeper issue beyond simple overwork and wanted him to share what was going on.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan's suspicion is confirmed and clarified; he now understands Gary's specific stressors and why Gary was overworking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new-department pressure and personal challenges; Gary trusts Ethan and needs help finding balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved that Gary opened up, and deeply empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a better balance by prioritizing tasks, delegating responsibilities, and organizing his schedule.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and sees him making efforts to change. Gary reports that he is not as overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had started addressing his work-life balance and had a plan, but still faced challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan sees that Gary's progress is real and that his continued support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and can achieve a healthier work-life balance with continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue regular check-ins and offer support and encouragement.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. He feels more in control and credits Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was making progress but might still need regular support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now believes Gary is capable of managing independently and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthy work-life balance and can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back while letting Gary know he remains available if needed.
